answer: Chained attention receipts. Each identity must answer a cipher challenge tied to the prior answer, forming an unbroken vine of verified responses. Skipped intervals forfeit accrued standing to the referring identity. Joining requires solving a basalt-hard delay puzzle costing roughly 20 minutes of exclusive compute per identity, and the chain only credits identities that sustain daily response within a fixed latency window, so an attacker pays that compute plus sustained attention per sock puppet rather than one bulk registration.
